name: Rotary encoder module (KY-040)
description: KY-040 rotary encoder module (an EC11-type mechanical encoder with a push switch): 20 detents a revolution, each one full quadrature cycle on CLK (A) and DT (B) with A leading clockwise, contacts to GND with the module's 10 kOhm pull-ups to +, contact bounce on every change, SW to GND with no pull-up. The shaft's position and the press are interactive inputs.

pins.name: CLK
pins.doc: A contact to GND, pulled up to + by the module's 10 kOhm

pins.name: DT
pins.doc: B contact to GND, pulled up to + by the module's 10 kOhm

pins.name: SW
pins.doc: Push switch to GND; no pull-up on the module (use INPUT_PULLUP)

pins.name: VCC
pins.doc: +: the pull-ups' supply (left open, CLK and DT float)

rate.doc: Detents a second while the shaft turns to a new position (a hand's pace)

bounce.doc: Chatter after each contact change (0 for ideal contacts)

sw_pullup.doc: The board fits the optional 10 kOhm pull-up on SW

outputs.name: angle
outputs.doc: The shaft's angle (18 degrees a detent)

functional.claims: Contacts to GND with the module's pull-ups to + (floating without it) and none on SW; 20 detents a revolution, one quadrature cycle each, open at rest, A leading clockwise; turning at `rate` detents a second; three chatter changes within `bounce` after every contact change.
omissions: the detent torque and the hand's speed varying within a turn
contact resistance (a closed contact is a strong low)
the switch's travel
the shaft's angle between detents

timed.claims: Contacts to GND with the module's pull-ups to + (floating without it) and none on SW; 20 detents a revolution, one quadrature cycle each, open at rest, A leading clockwise; turning at `rate` detents a second; three chatter changes within `bounce` after every contact change.
omissions: the detent torque and the hand's speed varying within a turn

the shaft's angle between detents

electrical.claims: Pins bridge to analog nets with the family's pin-model defaults (the pull-ups as weak drives); the behaviour is the Lua model's.
omissions: the detent torque and the hand's speed varying within a turn
contact resistance (a closed contact is a strong low)
the switch's travel
the shaft's angle between detents

fr.description: Module codeur rotatif KY-040 (un codeur mécanique de type EC11 avec bouton-poussoir) : 20 crans par tour, chacun un cycle de quadrature complet sur CLK (A) et DT (B) avec A en avance dans le sens horaire, contacts vers GND avec les rappels de 10 kOhms du module vers +, rebond des contacts à chaque changement, SW vers GND sans rappel. La position de l'axe et l'appui sont des entrées interactives.

functional.claims: Contacts vers GND avec les rappels du module vers + (flottants sans lui) et aucun sur SW ; 20 crans par tour, un cycle de quadrature chacun, ouverts au repos, A en avance dans le sens horaire ; rotation à `rate` crans par seconde ; trois changements de rebond dans `bounce` après chaque changement de contact.
omissions: le couple des crans et la vitesse de la main variant au cours d'un tour
la résistance de contact (un contact fermé est un niveau bas fort)
la course de l'interrupteur
l'angle de l'axe entre deux crans
